cases.criterion: Detailed and aggregate inventory projections and expanded versus nested procedure execution agree on protected material results and physical work; insufficient summaries cannot authorize physical execution.
Relevant child revisions invalidate every affected projection and no unrelated projection; internal invalidation leaves participant views unchanged; exact older projections reconstruct.
Joining needs an invitation and the joiner's paid acceptance; leaving or withdrawing permission preserves existing duties, ownership, completed work and history.
Shared capacity is retained only after all constituent work is performed and observed; a newcomer cannot perform or accept unacquired procedures; nested calls do not copy skill.
Partial work, cancellation, stale membership or consent, and overlapping resource contention preserve charges and prior effects without double spending; exact checkpoints continue correctly.

Raw transaction audit independently checks work, membership consent, collective decomposition, observations and capacity provenance; inherited U10 tests and witnesses and frozen baseline integrity pass.
